country.name: Central African Republic
country.jurisdictionNotice: Preschool, Fundamental 1, Fundamental 2, general secondary, technical and vocational training, and higher education require records from the authority competent for the exact level and institution.
country.languagePolicy: French and Sango are official languages with distinct instructional and community roles. Sango introduction, bilingual materials and other community languages require exact curriculum, phase, orthography, locality and community review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Central African reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, academic inspection, regulator or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry responsible for National Education governs preschool through secondary education and education statistics; technical and vocational responsibilities must be verified against the current government organization; MESRSIT governs higher education and research.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve academy or inspection, prefecture, sub-prefecture, locality, official school identity, sector, level, authorization, operating status and observation date. A statistical total or school map is not current authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution existence, legal authorization, exact program authorization, diploma authority, accreditation or evaluation, professional recognition and regional recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Education
authorities.role: preschool, fundamental and secondary education policy and administration

authorities.name: Inspectorate-General of National Education
authorities.role: pedagogical inspection and oversight within its mandate

authorities.name: Directorate-General for Studies, Statistics and Planning (DGESP)
authorities.role: education statistics, school map, planning and annual statistical yearbooks

authorities.name: Academic inspections and territorial education services
authorities.role: territorial school administration and current record validation

authorities.name: Authority responsible for technical and vocational education and training
authorities.role: provider, program and qualification oversight within the current assigned mandate

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research and Technological Innovation (MESRSIT)
Central African Digital Development Agency (ACDD)
authorities.role: digital regulation and published personal-data protection instruments within its mandate

authorities.name: Ministry and services responsible for child protection
authorities.role: child protection, safeguarding and referral under the Child Protection Code

curriculum.authority: Competent Ministry curriculum and inspection authority
curriculum.title: Official curricula for the exact education order, class, subject and language
curriculum.implementationRule: The 2020–2029 sector plan reported that the then-current curricula dated from 2009 and proposed reform and experimental Sango-medium introduction. A sector plan, proposed reform or pilot is not proof that a curriculum is nationally controlling in 2026; verify the exact approved document, instrument, phase and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Law, curriculum, syllabus, pilot, scripted lesson, approved textbook, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of National Education, DGESP and responsible territorial service
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: DGESP is responsible for the school map and annual statistical yearbook, but a verified public unified current directory containing every public and private school, authorization and operating status was not located. Approximate homepage totals must not be treated as school records.
requiredRecordFields: academy or inspection, prefecture, sub-prefecture and locality
public, private, community or confessional sector
observation year, source and review date

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Homepage approximations such as about 1.2 million learners, 3,500 schools and 15,000 teachers are not publication-ready catalog statistics without the underlying annual yearbook, observation year, definition, level, sector, geography and denominator. Preserve observation year separately from release date.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Competent current technical and vocational authority
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Provider approval, exact training-program approval, occupational standard, examination authority, qualification and award authority are separate claims. The current ministry assignment and every provider, site, program, modality, decision and validity must be verified.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: A ministry page naming Université de Bangui or another institution is not proof that every current program, campus, modality or award is authorized or accredited. Verify the institution act, exact program decision, diploma authority, site, modality, current status, validity and any professional or regional recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 24.001 of 20 November 2024 relating to personal data protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law No. 20.016 of 15 June 2020 establishing the Child Protection Code
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Verify commencement, the agency exercising each supervisory power, implementing procedures, legal basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, security, retention and incident duties under Law 24.001. The Child Protection Code requires current education-sector safeguarding, reporting, referral, consent, participation and emergency procedures before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French and Sango are official and educationally distinct. Sango-medium teaching must preserve the exact approved curriculum, implementation phase, class, transition model, orthography, teacher preparation and material version. Other community and Indigenous languages require community-specific review; automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Central African education reviewer is named.
National, territorial, technical-vocational and higher-education responsibilities are verified against the current government organization.
A verified current unified school directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves the source year, definition, level, sector, geography and publication date.
Every curriculum claim preserves order, class, subject, language, approving instrument, version, pilot or national status and effective year.
Sango plans and pilots are not represented as universal implementation without current evidence.
Every vocational and higher-education claim separately verifies provider or institution, exact program, decision, award, site, status and validity.
Privacy implementation and child-safeguarding procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
French, Sango and community-language resources preserve their distinct contexts.
